'''Starter decks''' were Decipher's preconstructed ''Star Wars'' CCG products: 60-card decks, one per side, sold with a rulebook alongside booster packs.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Starter decks ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Product !! Released !! Contents
|-
| [[Premiere Limited]] starter || December 1995 || 60 cards (44 commons, 14 uncommons, 2 rares) plus a rulebook, MSRP $9.95; 12-deck displays. Light and Dark versions.<ref name="encyc" />
|-
| [[Premiere Unlimited]] starter || 1996 || Same sizes, white border.<ref name="encyc" />
|-
| Japanese Premiere starter || April 1997 || Takara, 60 cards with a Japanese rulebook, MSRP ¥1400.<ref name="encyc" />
|-
| [[Special Edition]] starter || November 1998 || 22 fixed cards, 22 commons, 14 uncommons and 2 rares, plus [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Rulebook 2.0]] and the [[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Glossary 2.0]]; MSRP $12.95, 12 decks per box (6 per side).<ref name="encyc" />
|-
| [[Death Star II Starter Decks]] || 19 July 2000 || 60 cards, MSRP $10.95, with one starter-only rare: [[Admiral Ackbar]] (Light) or [[Admiral Piett]] (Dark).<ref name="encyc" />
|}

There were no [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] starter decks.<ref name="encyc" />

== Two-player introductory games ==
* [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] (February 1996) – two 60-card preconstructed decks, six exclusive premium cards, rules and one Premiere booster; MSRP $19.95.<ref name="encyc" />
* [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game]] (March 1997) – two 60-card decks, eight premium cards, rules and a sample-game booklet; MSRP $19.95.<ref name="encyc" />
